issues.detail: The Greek 'αρχιερευς' (archiereus) means 'high priest', but the Vietnamese translation uses 'thầy tế lễ' which generally means 'priest'. This misses the specific rank of 'high' (archi-) conveyed in the text.

The Greek 'του ενιαυτου εκεινου' refers to 'that year' (the year of his [the high priest's] ministry), but the Vietnamese 'cả trong năm ấy' (even in that year) slightly shifts the focus. However, the primary issue is the rank of the priest.
